_comment: Observations about sources the offline build cannot reach itself. A source we have SEEN in SharePoint but cannot yet parse is a different state from one we have no connection to, and the dashboard should say which. Each note is superseded the moment an authenticated refresh reads the source for real.

og_scorecard.file_name: Q226 - Operational Governance Scorecard - June 2026 - Nelson Portfolio_VALUES.xlsx
og_scorecard.reason: Refreshed 21 Sep 2026 and verified present. Microsoft Graph refuses to convert the workbook for text extraction, returning `notSupported` — what it returns for a file carrying an encrypting sensitivity label. Every copy of the scorecard behaves the same way, so this is a property of the scorecard rather than of one file, and credentials do not change it: a service principal without rights to the label reads ciphertext. The unblock is an unlabelled values copy from Group Finance, or the three rows saved out by someone whose own permissions open the file.
og_scorecard._superseded_diagnosis: An earlier note recorded this as a size/timeout problem needing the authenticated Graph download path. That was wrong — the reads did time out repeatedly, but the definitive Graph response is notSupported, and provisioning app credentials would not have helped. Kept here so the mistake is not quietly rewritten; not rendered on the dashboard.
